title: 第十三章 你们也多吃点第十四章 都怪之前没吃饱
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
小猫看着被递到自己嘴边的鱼肉，愣在原地。
只听叶晚秋叹了一口气，然后一只手揪住小猫的脖子，另一只手将鱼肉糊进了它的嘴里。
这一套动作十分流畅且速度，小猫还没有反应过来，嫩嫩的鱼肉就已经进了肚子。
它舔了一下嘴巴，继续盯着碗里的鱼肉。
于是接下来的场景就变成了叶晚秋用筷子挑刺，然后将鱼肉塞进小猫嘴里。
或许是觉得鱼肉好吃，小猫在嚼鱼肉的时候会不自觉的发出哼哼唧唧的声音，在察觉到自己发出这种声音的时候，又冷着脸闭上嘴。
叶晚秋这一辈子前前后后照顾过好几个孩子，给孩子喂饭这件事情已经到达了炉火纯青的程度。
此刻给这个小猫没饭，也没有什么不同。
而且从某种程度上来看，这只小猫不挑食，在喂饭的时候不会哭闹，比某些小孩还要听话。
将最后一块鱼肉塞进小猫嘴里后，叶晚秋拍拍手：“好了，没了，你吃饱了没有？”
小猫看向那只碗，确定里面没剩下肉，只有几根鱼刺后继续舔爪子。
叶晚秋瞧着可爱，抱着猫头又狠狠的撸了几把。
她看这只猫毛色油光水滑，应当是这门派里的弟子养的，能闻到这鱼的味道，应该是附近的弟子的院子。
“婆婆，我来了！”
院子里响起夏景景的声音，叶晚秋放下手里的猫立马走出去。
院子里夏景景将手里的剑放在桌子上，脸有些红扑扑的，额头上还有些汗珠。
“婆婆，想着吃到你做的饭，我练完剑立马就过来了！好香啊，今天我们吃什么东西？”
叶晚秋将打湿的帕子递给她，“我炖了红烧鱼，还有酸辣笋条，你先洗洗手，我去盛饭。”
“好！”
夏景景掏出门派里可以传讯令牌，让陈湛和崔向阳两个人快点过来，不然叶晚秋做出来的好吃的，她就要一个人全部吃光了。

叶晚秋将做好的鱼盛出来，饼子单独放在一个盘子里。
将东西端出去之后，这才发现那只小猫已经不见了。
见她好似在寻找着什么东西，夏景景开口问道：“怎么了婆婆？你在找什么吗？”
“刚才院子里来了一只小猫，兴许是闻到鱼肉的香味，我会给它吃了一些，吃饱之后就跑了。”叶晚秋说道。
听到这好，夏景景吐槽道：“那这只小猫也太没有良心了，都不知道谢谢婆婆。”
叶晚秋给她夹了一块没有刺的鱼肉，笑着说道：“如果它真会开口跟我说谢谢，那可要把我吓一跳。”
“婆婆，你可以养一只灵宠呀！”夏景景说道。
“什么灵宠？”
夏景景解释道：“就是一些开了灵智的小动物，与它们签订契约，做它们的主人，人和灵宠就可以心意相通，这样我们几个不在门派里的时候，也有东西可以陪着婆婆，给婆婆解闷。”
“居然还能这样？”这种事情再一次让叶晚秋惊讶。
如果能知道小动物的心思，那不真就和养孩子差不多了吗？
content_en:
The little cat stared at the fish meat that was handed to his mouth and froze on the spot.
Ye Wanqiu sighed, then grabbed the kitten's neck with one hand, and stuffed the fish paste into its mouth with the other hand.
This set of movements was very smooth and fast. Before the kitten could react, the tender fish meat had already entered its stomach.
It licked its mouth and continued to stare at the fish in the bowl.
So the next scene became Ye Wanqiu picking the thorns with chopsticks, and then stuffing the fish meat into the kitten's mouth.
Perhaps because it thinks the fish is delicious, the kitten will unconsciously make a humming sound when chewing the fish. When it realizes that it is making such a sound, it will shut its mouth with a cold face.
Ye Wanqiu has taken care of several children in his life, and has reached the level of proficiency in feeding them.
It makes no difference to give this kitten no food at this moment.
And to a certain extent, this kitten is not picky about food, does not cry when being fed, and is more obedient than some children.
After stuffing the last piece of fish meat into the kitten's mouth, Ye Wanqiu clapped his hands: "Okay, no more, are you full?"
The kitten looked at the bowl, made sure there was no meat left in it and only a few fish bones, then continued to lick its paws.
Ye Wanqiu looked at the cuteness, hugged the cat's head and stroked it a few times.
She saw that the cat's coat was shiny and smooth, and it must have been raised by a disciple in this sect. If she could smell the fish, it must be in the yard of a nearby disciple.
"Mother-in-law, I'm here!"
Xia Jingjing's voice sounded in the yard, and Ye Wanqiu put down the cat in his hand and walked out immediately.
In the yard, Xia Jingjing put the sword in her hand on the table, her face was a little red and there were beads of sweat on her forehead.
"Mother-in-law, thinking about eating the food you cooked, I came over right after I finished my sword practice! It smells so good. What should we eat today?"
Ye Wanqiu handed her the wet handkerchief, "I've stewed the braised fish and the spicy and sour bamboo shoots. You wash your hands first and I'll serve the rice."
"Okay!"
Xia Jingjing took out the summons token from the door and asked Chen Zhan and Cui Xiangyang to come over quickly, otherwise she would eat all the delicious food made by Ye Wanqiu by herself.
Ye Wanqiu took out the cooked fish and put the pancakes on a separate plate.
After taking the things out, I realized that the kitten was gone.
Seeing that she seemed to be looking for something, Xia Jingjing asked, "What's wrong, mother-in-law? Are you looking for something?"
"There was a kitten in the yard just now. Maybe it smelled the smell of fish. I gave it some food and ran away after it was full." Ye Wanqiu said.
After hearing this, Xia Jingjing complained: "Then this kitten is so heartless. He doesn't even know how to thank my mother-in-law."
Ye Wanqiu gave her a piece of fish meat without bones and said with a smile: "If it really can say thank you to me, it will scare me."
"Mother-in-law, you can keep a spiritual pet!" Xia Jingjing said.
"What spiritual pet?"
Xia Jingjing explained: "It's just some small animals that have developed spiritual intelligence. You sign a contract with them and become their masters. People and spiritual pets can communicate with each other. This way, when we are not in the sect, we will have something to accompany our mother-in-law and relieve her boredom."
"How can it still be like this?" This kind of thing once again surprised Ye Wanqiu.
If you could know the thoughts of small animals, wouldn't it be almost like raising a child?
